abbey-malt.name: Abbey Malt
abbey-malt.notes: Belgian toasted malt formulated for Trappist and Abbey ales, providing bread crust, nuttiness, and golden amber hue.

acidulated-malt.name: Acidulated Malt
acidulated-malt.notes: Contains naturally produced lactic acid (approx 1-2% by weight) to naturally lower mash pH without chemical acid additions.

amber-malt.name: Amber Malt
amber-malt.notes: Traditional dry-roasted British specialty malt offering distinct biscuit, toasted wood, and coffee notes.

aromatic-malt.name: Aromatic Malt
aromatic-malt.notes: High-kilned European malt providing intense malty aroma and clean syrupy malt flavor without harsh astringency.

basic-barley-malt.name: Basic Barley Malt
basic-barley-malt.notes: Standard standard 2-row / 6-row brewer's malt providing high diastatic power and clean malty backbone.

biscuit-malt.name: Biscuit Malt
biscuit-malt.notes: Warm-air roasted Belgian malt delivering dry, crisp, saltine cracker and warm toasted bread flavors.

black-malt.name: Black Malt
black-malt.notes: Black Patent malt. High-temperature roasted malt giving sharp, dry, acrid, burnt bread tones and deep black color.

brown-malt.name: Brown Malt
brown-malt.notes: Historical English kiln-roasted malt. Delivers dry, biscuit, coffee-like, and charred wood complexity in porters.

buckwheat-malt.name: Buckwheat Malt
buckwheat-malt.notes: Gluten-free malted pseudocereal delivering earthy, nutty, and savory grain characteristics.

caraamber.name: CaraAmber
caraamber.notes: German drum-roasted caramel malt delivering toffee, bread crust, and warm caramel complexity.

caraaroma.name: CaraAroma
caraaroma.notes: Dark German caramel malt imparting deep reddish-brown color, dark fruit, and roasted caramel aromas.

carabelge.name: CaraBelge
carabelge.notes: Enhances golden to amber color while contributing notes of mild honey, caramel, and biscuit.

carabohemian.name: CaraBohemian
carabohemian.notes: Bohemian drum-roasted caramel malt offering rich bread crust and dark toffee flavors for Czech dark lagers.

carafa-i.name: CaraFa I
carafa-i.notes: German dark roasted specialty malt. Imparts dark color and fine roasted coffee flavors in Schwarzbier.

carafa-ii.name: CaraFa II
carafa-ii.notes: Mid-tier Carafa malt delivering deep black-brown color and rich espresso aroma.

carafa-iii.name: CaraFa III
carafa-iii.notes: Darkest Carafa malt for maximum color contribution and robust roast character.

carafa-special-i.name: CaraFa Special I
carafa-special-i.notes: Dehusked Carafa I. Provides clean dark color and smooth roasted finish without harsh bitterness.

carafa-special-ii.name: CaraFa Special II
carafa-special-ii.notes: Dehusked Carafa II. Imparts deep color and mild dark-chocolate notes with reduced astringency.

carafa-special-iii.name: CaraFa Special III
carafa-special-iii.notes: Dehusked Carafa III. Maximum color depth with ultra-smooth cocoa and mild roast profile.

caragold.name: CaraGold
caragold.notes: Low-color caramel malt imparting sweet toffee notes, improved body, and brilliant golden color.

carahell.name: CaraHell
carahell.notes: Light German caramel malt enhancing body, softness, and mild caramel sweetness in pale lagers.

caramel-crystal-malt-10l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 10L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-30l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 30L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-40l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 40L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-45l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 45L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-50l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 50L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-55l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 55L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-60l.name: Caramel/Crystal Malt 60L
caramel-crystal-malt-60l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 60L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-70l.name: Caramel/Crystal Malt 70L
caramel-crystal-malt-70l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 70L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-75l.name: Caramel/Crystal Malt 75L
caramel-crystal-malt-75l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 75L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-80l.name: Caramel/Crystal Malt 80L
caramel-crystal-malt-80l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 80L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramel-crystal-malt-90l.name: Caramel/Crystal Malt 90L
caramel-crystal-malt-90l.notes: Caramel/Crystal Malt – 90L (Caramel/Crystal Malt). Traditional specialty brewing fermentable.

caramunich-i.name: CaraMunich I
caramunich-i.notes: Type I CaraMunich. Introduces deep amber color, rich maltiness, and caramel flavors in dark lagers.

caramunich-ii.name: CaraMunich II
caramunich-ii.notes: Type II CaraMunich. Adds pronounced dark caramel, cookie, and toasted bread notes in bocks and märzens.

caramunich-iii.name: CaraMunich III
caramunich-iii.notes: Type III CaraMunich. Full-flavored dark caramel malt delivering raisin, plum, and intense malt richness.

carapils-carafoam.name: CaraPils / CaraFoam
carapils-carafoam.notes: Dextrin malt processed to maximize foam stability, head retention, and creaminess without adding color or flavor.

carared.name: CaraRed
carared.notes: Medium crystal malt engineered to enhance full body and deep red/copper hue in red ales and ambers.

cararye.name: CaraRye
cararye.notes: Caramelized malted rye. Adds deep reddish color, velvety mouthfeel, and spicy rye bread complexity.

caravienne.name: CaraVienne
caravienne.notes: Belgian crystal malt yielding golden hues and delicate toffee and biscuit notes in Belgian ales.

carawheat.name: CaraWheat
carawheat.notes: Caramelized wheat malt. Infuses dark wheat beers with rich body, dark color, and subtle roast-caramel aroma.

chit-malt.name: Chit Malt
chit-malt.notes: Very lightly germinated malt rich in high-molecular proteins. Enhances head retention and foam without adding haze.

chocolate-malt.name: Chocolate Malt
chocolate-malt.notes: Essential dark ale grain. Imparts rich cocoa, dark baker's chocolate, and nutty roasted flavors without harsh ashiness.

coffee-malt.name: Coffee Malt
coffee-malt.notes: Gently roasted malt producing smooth fresh brewed coffee and roasted nut aromas.

cookie-malt.name: Cookie Malt
cookie-malt.notes: Lightly toasted malt creating sweet pastry, butter cookie, and warm bakery aroma.

dark-chocolate-malt.name: Dark Chocolate Malt
dark-chocolate-malt.notes: Deeply roasted malt delivering intense dark chocolate, espresso, and opaque black color.

dark-wheat-malt.name: Dark Wheat Malt
dark-wheat-malt.notes: Kilned malted wheat for dunkelweizens and dark ales, contributing bready bread-crust tones and creamy body.

debittered-black-malt.name: Debittered Black Malt
debittered-black-malt.notes: Husk-stripped black malt providing deep pitch-black color without bitter astringent bite.

diastatic-malt.name: Diastatic Malt
diastatic-malt.notes: Super high-enzyme malt engineered to convert high fractions of unmalted adjuncts in the mash.

diastatic-wheat-malt.name: Diastatic Wheat Malt
diastatic-wheat-malt.notes: Malted wheat optimized for exceptionally high alpha and beta amylase enzymatic potency.

emmer-malt.name: Emmer Malt
emmer-malt.notes: Ancient farro grain malt providing deep golden color and rustic nutty breadiness.

extra-dark-wheat-malt.name: Extra Dark Wheat Malt
extra-dark-wheat-malt.notes: Intensely kilned dark wheat malt imparting deep brown highlights and complex toasty aromas.

extra-pale-ale-malt.name: Extra Pale Ale Malt
extra-pale-ale-malt.notes: Lightened pale ale malt tailored for modern hazy IPAs and delicate blonde ales.

flaked-barley.name: Flaked Barley
flaked-barley.notes: Unmalted rolled barley flakes providing protein and beta-glucans for dense, creamy head retention and grainy body.

flaked-corn.name: Flaked Corn
flaked-corn.notes: Lightens body and color while contributing subtle sweet corn flavor in American lagers, cream ales, and pre-prohibition styles.

flaked-oats.name: Flaked Oats
flaked-oats.notes: Pre-gelatinized rolled oats. Imparts creamy mouthfeel, silky body, and haze stability in NEIPAs and oatmeal stouts.

flaked-quinoa.name: Flaked Quinoa
flaked-quinoa.notes: Gluten-free pseudocereal flakes adding nutty flavor, light body, and amino acid nutrition.

flaked-rice.name: Flaked Rice
flaked-rice.notes: Lightens body, alcohol perception, and color to maximum dryness in Japanese dry lagers and American light lagers.

flaked-rye.name: Flaked Rye
flaked-rye.notes: Gelatinized rye flakes contributing sharp spicy character and full, chewy viscosity to the wort.

flaked-spelt.name: Flaked Spelt
flaked-spelt.notes: Rustic unmalted ancient grain flakes enhancing foam and gentle nutty complexity.

flaked-wheat.name: Flaked Wheat
flaked-wheat.notes: Essential for Belgian witbiers. Enhances mouthfeel, cloudiness, and clean cereal grain sweetness.

golden-naked-oats.name: Golden Naked Oats
golden-naked-oats.notes: Crystal malted huskless oats. Imparts creamy silkiness, nutty sweetness, and toffee highlights.

golden-promise-malt.name: Golden Promise Malt
golden-promise-malt.notes: Scottish spring barley variety with sweet, clean, full-bodied malt sweetness. Common in Scotch ales and IPAs.

green-malt.name: Green Malt
green-malt.notes: Germinated unkilned malt with high moisture and fresh grassy enzymatic characteristics.

honey-malt.name: Honey Malt
honey-malt.notes: Brumalt style malt imparting intense sweet honey, graham cracker, and toasted grain character in small doses.

light-coffee-malt.name: Light Coffee Malt
light-coffee-malt.notes: Lightly kilned coffee malt offering subtle roasted coffee notes without astringent bitterness.

maize.name: Maize
maize.notes: Unmalted corn providing clean neutral fermentables to lighten body and crisp up pale lagers.

malt-extract.name: Malt Extract
malt-extract.notes: Concentrated wort extract derived from base barley malt. Used for yeast starters, gravity boosts, or extract brewing.

maris-otter-malt.name: Maris Otter Malt
maris-otter-malt.notes: Celebrated traditional British heritage barley variety renowned for deep rich nutty and cracker complexity.

melanoidin-malt.name: Melanoidin Malt
melanoidin-malt.notes: Promotes deep red color, velvety mouthfeel, and rich decoction-like maltiness in lagers and bocks.

mild-ale-malt.name: Mild Ale Malt
mild-ale-malt.notes: High kilned traditional English base malt offering warm toasty bread crust tones for session ales.

millet-malt.name: Millet Malt
millet-malt.notes: Primary gluten-free brewing grain offering mild, crisp, clean cereal profile.

munich-dark-malt.name: Munich Dark Malt
munich-dark-malt.notes: Munich Type II. Highly kilned for deep amber to coppery color and pronounced toasted bread crust intensity.

munich-light-malt.name: Munich Light Malt
munich-light-malt.notes: Munich Type I. Imparts subtle malty sweetness and golden-amber highlights without overwhelming roastiness.

munich-malt.name: Munich Malt
munich-malt.notes: Rich, melanoidin-dense German malt kilned to develop distinct bready, bread-crust, and biscuit flavors.

oat-malt.name: Oat Malt
oat-malt.notes: Malted husked oats providing silky texture, enhanced head retention, and delicate nutty flavor.

pale-ale-malt.name: Pale Ale Malt
pale-ale-malt.notes: Fully modified British or American pale malt with rich biscuity, malty complexity for ales.

pale-chocolate.name: Pale Chocolate
pale-chocolate.notes: Lightly roasted chocolate malt with mellow milk chocolate, mocha, and toasted hazelnut nuances.

pale-wheat-malt.name: Pale Wheat Malt
pale-wheat-malt.notes: Malted white wheat delivering clean crisp wheat character and high extract potential with low color.

peated-malt.name: Peated Malt
peated-malt.notes: Malt smoked over burning peat bog moss. Delivers earthy, phenolic, medicinal smoke character for Scotch ales.

pilsner-light-malt.name: Pilsner Light Malt
pilsner-light-malt.notes: Extra pale pilsner malt kilned gently to preserve maximum enzyme activity and very low color.

pilsner-malt.name: Pilsner Malt
pilsner-malt.notes: Lightest colored European base malt. Delicate sweet, grainy, bready flavor essential for continental lagers.

rice-hulls.name: Rice Hulls
rice-hulls.notes: Inert filter aid with zero extract or flavor contribution. Prevents stuck sparges when mashing high wheat, rye, or oat ratios.

roasted-barley-malt.name: Roasted Barley Malt
roasted-barley-malt.notes: Unmalted roasted whole barley. Signature component of dry Irish stout, lending distinctive coffee and bitter roasted flavor.

roasted-millet-malt.name: Roasted Millet Malt
roasted-millet-malt.notes: Gluten-free roasted alternative grain offering deep color and chocolate-coffee profile.

roasted-rye-malt.name: Roasted Rye Malt
roasted-rye-malt.notes: Roasted malted rye providing spicy, earthy, dark-chocolate, and coffee nuances.

roasted-spelt-malt.name: Roasted Spelt Malt
roasted-spelt-malt.notes: Ancient grain roasted malt giving rustic nutty cocoa complexity.

roasted-wheat-malt.name: Roasted Wheat Malt
roasted-wheat-malt.notes: Roasted huskless wheat. Adds dark color, smooth creamy mouthfeel, and dark chocolate notes to stouts and porters.

rye-malt.name: Rye Malt
rye-malt.notes: Malted rye grain. Adds distinctive spicy, crisp, earthy rye flavor and velvety mouthfeel.

salty-caramel-malt.name: Salty Caramel Malt
salty-caramel-malt.notes: Specialty toasted/caramel malt offering savory-sweet caramelized toffee tones.

small-spelt-malt.name: Small Spelt Malt
small-spelt-malt.notes: Einkorn malt. Delicate sweet ancient grain with high protein and silky body.

smoke-malt.name: Smoke Malt
smoke-malt.notes: Barley malt smoked over seasoned beechwood logs. Signature ingredient for Bamberg Rauchbier.

spelt-malt.name: Spelt Malt
spelt-malt.notes: Ancient wheat variety producing soft, nutty, rustic flavor and excellent foam stability.

stout-malt.name: Stout Malt
stout-malt.notes: Irish pale malt kilned specifically to pair with unmalted roasted barley in dry Irish stouts.

toffee-malt.name: Toffee Malt
toffee-malt.notes: Specialty malt prepared to enhance body and introduce subtle caramelized toffee notes.

torrified-barley-malt.name: Torrified Barley Malt
torrified-barley-malt.notes: Popped whole barley grain providing foam stability and grainy character in traditional British bitters.

torrified-oats.name: Torrified Oats
torrified-oats.notes: Heat-puffed whole oats adding body and smooth mouthfeel.

torrified-wheat-malt.name: Torrified Wheat Malt
torrified-wheat-malt.notes: Heat-puffed unmalted wheat. Improves head retention and adds clean rustic wheat character without requiring a cereal cook.

triticale-malt.name: Triticale Malt
triticale-malt.notes: Wheat-rye hybrid combining the bready smoothness of wheat with the spicy bite of rye.

unmalted-barley.name: Unmalted Barley
unmalted-barley.notes: Raw barley grain contributing grainy, cereal notes and heavy foam proteins.

unmalted-buckwheat.name: Unmalted Buckwheat
unmalted-buckwheat.notes: Raw buckwheat for rustic earthy gluten-free brewing.

unmalted-emmer.name: Unmalted Emmer
unmalted-emmer.notes: Raw ancient farro kernel for traditional rustic grain beers.

unmalted-millet.name: Unmalted Millet
unmalted-millet.notes: Raw millet grains for gluten-free cereal mashes.

unmalted-oat.name: Unmalted Oat
unmalted-oat.notes: Raw unmalted oats for rich silkiness and body.

unmalted-rye.name: Unmalted Rye
unmalted-rye.notes: Raw whole rye kernel offering intense peppery rye spice.

unmalted-spelt.name: Unmalted Spelt
unmalted-spelt.notes: Raw ancient spelt grain for soft cereal body.

unmalted-triticale.name: Unmalted Triticale
unmalted-triticale.notes: Raw wheat-rye hybrid grain offering crispness and body.

unmalted-wheat.name: Unmalted Wheat
unmalted-wheat.notes: Raw unmalted wheat grain. Key traditional ingredient in Belgian lambic and witbier for starch haze and crisp flavor.

vienna-malt.name: Vienna Malt
vienna-malt.notes: Lightly toasted continental base malt providing golden amber color and rich toasty malt aroma without sweetness.

wheat-malt.name: Wheat Malt
wheat-malt.notes: Huskless malted wheat rich in protein. Boosts head retention, foam stability, and body in weissbiers and wheat ales.

whisky-malt.name: Whisky Malt
whisky-malt.notes: Distiller's malt optimized for high fermentability, soluble extract, and enzyme potential.
